prompt:
text
Build a beautifully crafted, privacy-first personal replacement for the core utility loop of Lunatask, combining task planning, habit tracking, and mental well-being in a calming interface.
Use exactly this stack: Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript + SQLite.
Primary job: Build a local-only desktop utility focusing on neurodivergent-friendly task management, life tracking, and personal CRM functionalities.
Core Features:
- Implement flexible, stress-reducing task workflows based on the "Now/Later" and "Must/Should/Want" methodologies, with Work-in-Progress (WIP) limits.
- Build an integrated life-tracking module for daily habits, energy levels, and mood tracking, visualized in simple, encouraging charts.
- Create a lightweight personal CRM (Relationship Manager) to track contacts, custom relationship fields, and "time to reconnect" reminders.
- Include a secure, private journaling section that links contextually to tasks or moods.
Design & Aesthetics:
- Design a calming, premium user interface with a meticulously crafted dark mode, using soft gradients, rounded corners, and glassmorphism to reduce cognitive overload.
- Employ a soothing, harmonious color palette tailored to reduce anxiety (e.g., soft pastels in dark mode) rather than aggressive primary colors.
- Use modern, approachable typography (like Outfit or Inter) and ensure the layout is highly structured with clear, "finger-friendly" interaction areas.
- Incorporate subtle, delightful micro-animations for checking off tasks or logging habits to provide positive reinforcement without distraction.
Technical Constraints:
- Start from an empty folder and create the complete working Tauri project.
- Make the app strictly local, single-user, and private. Store all data in a local SQLite database file, ensuring no data leaves the machine.
- Do not add analytics, telemetry, or third-party accounts.
- Include realistic sample data that is easily deletable.
- Implement comprehensive keyboard navigation and sensible contrast for accessibility.
- Include robust import and JSON export functionality.
- Deliberately exclude cross-device sync, vendor-maintained updates, and OS-level integrations.
- Write focused unit tests for the task prioritization logic and habit tracking streaks. Add an end-to-end smoke test.
- Provide a clear README outlining architecture, data location, and backup strategy. Add scripts for install, dev, test, and build. Fix all errors before finishing.
